`final class SignalReplayClass`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplayClass.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/signal/replay/SignalReplayClass.java)

Bytecode of one class of the application, read once for the replay, with the analyses of its methods.

## Description

When the class comes from a folder, the replay reads its `.class` file again after it changed on disk, as with hot reload.

## Learn more

- [How signals work](/use/in-depth/how-signals-work/)

## Creation details

<a id="SignalReplayClass-factory-read"></a>

### read

`SignalReplayClass read(String name, Class<?> type, ClassLoader loader)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Reads the bytecode of the class `name`, from the file of `type` when it has one, otherwise through `loader`.
Throws a [`SignalReplayException`](/reference/signals/signalreplayexception/) when no class loader gives its bytecode.
